newsitem.title: EU: Reuter European Court of Justice Diary for Tuesday, June 24 - Thursday, July 3.
newsitem.headline: Reuter European Court of Justice Diary for Tuesday, June 24 - Thursday, July 3.

text.p: (All venues Luxembourg, Plateau de Kirchberg)
TUESDAY, JUNE 24

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-122/95 Germany v/ Council: external relations. Annulment of the act approving, in the name of the community, the framework agreement concluded between the EC and Costa Rica, Colombia, Nicaragua and Venezuela on bananas. Article 1, paragraph 1, first dash, of Council directive 94/800/EEC of December 22, 1994, on the conclusion in the name of the community, insofar as it regards matters within its competence, of the Uruguay Round multilateral negotiations (1986-1994). Annex I A of the agreement instituting the WTO. Point 1 of the Marrakech protocol - article 4, paragraph 1 of the agriculture accord. - Opinion C-317/95 Canadane Cheese Trading: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation EC treaty articles 30 and 36 - national regulation reserving the use of the traditional denomination "feta" to cheese answering certain conditions as to composition and method of fabrication. - Opinion joined cases C-364/95, C-365/95 T. Port: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 234, first line - primacy of GATT articles I, I and III in relation to articles 17 to 19 of Council regulation 404/93 of February 13, 1993, and Commission regulation 478/95 of March 1, 1995. Validity of Commission regulation 478/95 on application modes complementary to regulation 404/93 regarding tariff quota arrangements for banana imports into the community and amending regulation 1442/93. - Oral procedure C-213/96 Outokumpu: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 9, 12 and 95. National tax policy on electrical energy production and imports. Variable tax rate according to energy source used in national production. Flat rate for imported electricity. - (1030/0830 GMT) Oral procedure C-171/96 Pereira Roque: membership. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 4 of protocol 3 of the act annexed to the membership treaty of 22 January, 1972, on the Anglo-Normand islands and the Isle of Man. Jersey authorities' power to expel a community member from their territory.
WEDNESDAY, JUNE 25

FOURTH CHAMBER (1030/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-237/96 Amelynck: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity of Council regulation 222/77 of December 13, 1976, on community transit and of Commission regulation 223/77 of December 22, 1976, simplifying, and laying down application provisions for community transit policy insofar as said regulation establishes the rule according to which the community nature of goods must be reported, except in circumstances specifically provided for, in transit document T2 or T2L. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 9 and 10 and of articles 37, paragraph 2 and 39, paragraph 2 of Council regulation 222/77.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure C-172/96 First National Bank of Chicago: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Currency operations. Transactions between parties for the reciprocal purchase of a sum agreed in different currencies and for which the parties have fixed the currencies in question, the sums to purchase and sell, and the date of liquidation.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-285/94 Italy v/ Commission: agriculture. Annulment of commission regulation 1840/94 of July 27, 1994, fixing olive and oil production for the 1993/1994 campaign. Adjustments in relation to givens furnished by Italy. - Judgment joined cases C-304/94, C-330/94, C-342/94, C-224/95 Tombesi: environment and consumers. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 91/156/EEC amending Council directive 75/442/EEC of July 15, 1975, on waste, Council directive 91/689/EEC of December 12, 1991, on dangerous waste and of Council regulation 259/93 of February 1, 1993, on the supervision and control of waste transfers in and out of the community. Notion of waste, "waste to be revalorised", reusable residues. - Judgment C-45/95 Commission v/ Italy: taxation. Non-respect. Failure to conform to article 12, point B(c) of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Exemptions within the country. Deliveries of goods used exclusively for a deductible activity. Deliveries of goods the acquisition or use of which caused exclusion from the right to a deduction. - Judgment C-114/96 Kieffer: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity of Council regulation 3330/91 of November 7, 1991, on statistics related to the trading of goods between member states. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 30 and 36. Interpretation of EC treaty article 3B, line 3 as inserted by article G, point 5 of the Maastricht Treaty. Principle of proportionality as regards national law that imposes penal sanctions on refusals to furnish information required in application of the INTRASTAT collection system. - Judgment C-131/96 Mora Romero: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 6, 48 and 51 and of article 7 of Council regulation 1612/68, of October 15, 1968, on freedom of movement for workers within the community. National law on social security payments allowing a prolongation of the payment period for orphans to take into account a period of interruption in their training due to compulsory military service. Service effected in a member state other than the state of the orphan's nationality. - Oral procedure C-132/96 Stinco: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 46, paragraph 2(a), of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU as amended and updated by Council regulation 2001/83 of June 2, 1983. Old age pension. Calculation of theoretical amount, taking into account the amount required to attain the minimum provided for in law.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment T-7/96 Perillo v/ Commission: external relations. Action for compensation for damages supposedly sustained by the claimant following commission conduct regarding the execution of a supply contract for empty gas bottles concluded between the claimant and the Societe Mauritanienne de Gaz in the framework of "Programme Regional Gaz", financed by the EDF. - Oral procedure T-331/94 IPK v/ Commission: social policy. Annulment of Commission decision of August 3, 1994, contained in letter of August 3, 1994, refusing to grant supplementary financial aid to a project presented by the claimant in the framework of a call for proposals launched by the commission in view of supporting pilot projects in the tourism and environment sector. - (1500/1300 GMT) Oral procedure T-246/93 Buehring v/ Council and Commission: agriculture. Appeal for compensation. Non contractual responsibility of the Community following from Council regulation 857/84 and Commission regulation 1371/84. Milk production quota arrangements. Exclusion of former beneficiaries of a non-marketing subsidy under regulation 764/89 (formerly C-264/93).

THIRD CHAMBER (enlarged)(0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure joined cases T-295/94, T-304/94, T-308/94, T-309/94, T-310/94, T-311/94, T-317/94, T-319/94, T-327/94, T-334/94f T-337/94, T-338/94, T-347/94, T-348/94, T-352/94, T-354/94 Buchmann v/ Commission: competition. Annulment of Commission decision 94/601 of July 13, 1994, on an application procedure for EC treaty article 85. Reuter European Court of Justice Diary (page 2/2)
THURSDAY, JUNE 26

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-368/95 Familiapress Zeitungsverlag: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 30. National law forbidding the dissemination of periodicals inviting participation in game contests (crosswords, etc.) offering prizes of not insubstantial value. - Opinion C-188/95 Fantask: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 4, 10 and 12, paragraph l(e) of Council directive 69/335/EEC of July 17, 1969, on indirect taxes on the raising of capital. Taxes of a remunerative character. Notion. Taxes imposed not connected to the service provided according to the company register. Flat rate of tax. consideration of the real cost of the operation. Recovery of payment made by mistake. Repayment by member states of taxes collected in violation of community law.

THIRD CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure C-143/96 Leonhard Knubben Speditions: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of sub-position 0904 20 of the combined nomenclature. Pimentos dried and cut into 4 by 8 mm pieces.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment joined cases C-370/95, C-371/95, C-372/95 Careda: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 33 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. National tax on the exploitation of gaming machines calculated on the stakes, where the repercussion on the consumer by the taxable party is not provided for. - Judgment C-329/96 Commission v/ Greece: environment and consumers. Non-respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 92/43/EEC of May 21, 1992, on the conservation of natural habitats, and wild flora and fauna. - Opinion C-375/95 Commission v/ Greece: taxation. Non-respect. Breach of EC treaty article 95. Discriminatory tax on used imported automotive vehicles. - Opinion joined cases C-69/96, C-70/96, C-71/96, C-72/96, C-73/96, C-74/96, C-75/96, C-76/96, C-77/96, C-78/96, C-79/96 Garofalo: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 177. Notion of national jurisdiction. State Councillor held in the context of an administrative appeal to the president of the republic. Interpretation of article 7, paragraph 2 of Council directive 86/457/EEC of September 15, 1986, on specific training for general doctors. Notion of "established rights".

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion joined cases C-232/95, C-233/95 Commission v/ Greece: environment and consumers. Non-respect. Faulty application of Council directive 76/464/EEC of May 4, 1976, on pollution caused by certain dangerous substances dumped into the community's aquatic environment. Absence of programmes to reduce water pollution in lake Vegoritis and the Soulos river and measures subjecting the dumping of wastes by industry and establishments in the region concerned to prior authorisation. - Opinion C-280/95 Commission v/ Italy: state aid. Non-respect. Failure to conform to Commission decision 93/496/EEC of June 9, 1993, on state aid C 32/92 (ex NN 67/92) - Italy (tax credit for professional road hauliers). - Opinion C-356/95 Witt: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council regulation 1765/92 of June 30, 1992, laying down a support structure for the producers of certain arable crops. Limitation of national competence to determine "production regions" within the meaning of article 3, paragraph 1, first line. Obligation to indicate "judgment criteria". Taking into account of soil fertility. - Opinion C-369/95 Somalfruit: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Compatibility of Council regulation 404/93 of February 13, 1993, on the common organisation of markets in the banana sector with the ACP-EEC Lome convention. Compatibility with regulation 404/93 of Commission regulation 1442/93 of June 10, 1993, laying down application measures on banana imports into the community and of regulation 1443/93 of June 10, 1993, on temporary application measures on banana imports into the community. Bananas from Somalia. - Opinion C-42/96 Immobiliare SIF: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 4, 7 and 10 of Council directive 69/335/EEC of July 17, 1969, on indirect taxes on the raising of capital as amended by Council directive 73/80/EEC of April 9, 1973, on the fixing of common rates on property tax. Collection of a tax on the increase in value of real estate property. - Opinion C-206/96 Commission v/ Luxembourg; environment and consumers. Non-respect. Failure to have fulfilled obligations arising from Council directive 76/464/EEC of May 4, 1976, on pollution caused by certain dangerous substances dumped in the community's aquatic environment. Non-adaptation of pollution reduction programmes.
PROVISIONAL AGENDA FOR TUESDAY-THURSDAY, JULY 1-3
TUESDAY, JULY 1
COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-85/96 Martinez Sala: free movement of persons.
SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure C-125/96 Simon: agriculture.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure C-62/96 Commission v/ Greece: free movement of persons. - (1015/0815 GMT) Oral procedure joined cases C-253/96, C-254/96, C-255/96, C-256/96, C-257/96, C-258/96 Kampelmann: social policy. - (1530/1330 GMT) Oral procedure C-366/96 Cordelle: free movement of persons.
SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure C-184/96 Commission v/ France: free movement of goods.
WEDNESDAY, JULY 2
COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure C-157/96 National Farmers' Union: agriculture. - Oral procedure C-180/96 United Kingdom v/ Commission: agriculture.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment T-28/96 Chew v/ Commission: status of officials. Case reserved for officials. - Oral procedure T-172/96 Chevalier-Delanoue v/ Council: status of officials. Case reserved for officials.
THURSDAY, JULY 3
COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure C-80/96 Quelle Schickedanz: free movement of goods.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-97/96 Daihatsu Deutschland: company law. Oral procedure C-92/96 Commission v/ Spain: environment and consumers. - (1530/1330 GMT) Oral procedure C-7/95 P John Deere v/ Commission: competition. - (1615/1415 GMT) Oral procedure C-8/95 P New Holland Ford v/ Commission: competition.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-269/95 Benincasa: judicial competence convention/execution of decisions. - Judgment C-330/95 Goldsmiths: taxation. - Judgment C-60/96 Commission v/ France: taxation. - Opinion C-177/96 Banque Indosuez: ECSC. - Oral procedure C-192/96 Beside: environment and consumers. - Oral procedure C-193/96 Richard Buchen: environment and consumers. - Oral procedure C-203/96 Dusseldorp: environment and consumers.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure T-101/96 Wolf v/ Commission: status of officials. Case reserved for officials. - Oral procedure T-223/95 Ronchi v/ Commission: status of officials. Case reserved for officials.
